provenance: Codex subagent review of immutable prepared inputs; findings checked against source, separate from deterministic validation.
rationale: record reloads current Inventory and validates snapshots before saving. check resolves same-subject supersession, then requires every remaining active review to be current and affirmative; it does not fall back to an older superseded approval. Tests explicitly cover negatives, inconclusive records, new context and stale replacements. FutureNote is excluded only from correspondence preparation/recording, and drafts cannot receive affirmative correspondence; editorial subjects are handled separately.
limitations: This is a source-level comparison of the retained authored unit, exact cited declarations/tests and policy. It is not proof of exhaustive implementation behavior, a browser rendering test or a claim that every conservative context file was read. The reviewer authored the new audit integration/tests, then performed this separate comparison pass; no independence from that implementation is claimed.
